title: Ornamental Fan
description: Every time you play 3 Attacks in a single turn, gain 4 Block.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks the number of Attack cards played during the player's turn. When the count reaches a multiple of the threshold (default 3), the player gains Block. The counter resets at the start of each turn.
